gap.title: Probe: at the 4 x 4 base point with 2 on the diagonal and 1 elsewhere, no six-dimensional level space keeps the permanent at 65
gap.statement: ¬ (∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 4 → ℂ), Module.finrank ℂ L = 6 ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, Matrix.permanent (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin 4) => (if i = j then (2 : ℂ) else 1) + t (i, j)) = 65)
